metadata.name: hashfox
metadata.description: HashFox — unified paper-trading program (prediction markets, spot, perps, limit orders)

instructions.name: cancel_limit_order
docs: Cancel a pending limit order. Returns locked margin to available balance.

instructions.name: close_prediction_auto
docs: Executor-only auto-close when SL or TP is met on a prediction position.

instructions.name: close_prediction_position
docs: Manually close a prediction position at `current_price` (full exit).

instructions.name: close_trading_position
docs: Manually close an active trading position at `current_price`.

instructions.name: initialize_user_account
docs: Create the user's unified paper-trading account and credit 100,000 USD
that is shared across prediction markets, spot, perps, and limit orders.
Pays a small real SOL entry fee to the treasury.

instructions.name: open_limit_order
docs: Place a limit order (spot or perp). Margin is locked immediately; the
position sits in `PendingFill` until an executor fills it at a

instructions.name: open_market_position
docs: Open a market position (spot or perp), filled immediately at `entry_price`.

fields.name: usd_balance
docs: Unified USD balance (6 decimals). Includes margin currently locked in
open trading positions; available = usd_balance - locked_margin_usd.
